test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the Magento admin panel at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/ and the invoice management page at http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order_invoice/. The agent also performed frontend searches for 'invoice' and 'order' terms. Since no specific invoice/order numbers or date ranges were visible in the URLs, and the agent successfully authenticated, I've used default Magento admin credentials that are commonly used in dockerized/local Magento installations. The empty values for invoice_number, order_number, and date filters reflect that the agent didn't appear to use these specific parameters in the execution.
